welcome.subject: Welcome to OutMass — your first campaign in 3 steps
welcome.text:
Hi Ada,

Thanks for signing in to OutMass! You're set up to send personalized
mail-merge campaigns straight from your own Outlook account.

Your first campaign in 3 steps:

1. Open Outlook on the web and click the round OM button in the
   bottom-right corner — it opens the OutMass panel.
2. In the panel, upload your recipients as a CSV (there's a template
   inside), write your email, and drop {{firstName}} anywhere to
   personalize each message.
3. Click Preview or send yourself a Test Send, then hit Send. OutMass
   paces delivery and tracks opens, clicks and replies.

You start on the Free plan (250 emails/month) — you can upgrade anytime
from the panel when you need more.

Hit a snag or have a question? Just reply to this email — it comes
straight to me and I usually answer within a few hours.

Ali
Founder, OutMass
https://getoutmass.com

P.S. The panel lives in Outlook on the web — in a browser tab, not the
Windows/Mac desktop app. Whichever address your account uses is fine
(outlook.office.com, outlook.live.com and outlook.cloud.microsoft all
work). If you don't see the round button, refresh your Outlook tab once.

quota_capped.subject: 250 recipients saved — they'll be sent automatically
quota_capped.text:
Hi Ada,

Your campaign just reached your monthly limit of 2,500 emails. The
remaining 250 recipients are safely saved — nothing was lost, and
there's nothing you need to do.

OutMass will send them automatically on September 14, when your monthly
quota resets.

Want them out sooner? Upgrading raises your limit immediately and the
saved recipients go out on the next sending run — open the OutMass panel
and click Upgrade Plan.

Questions? Just reply — it comes straight to me.

Ali
Founder, OutMass
https://getoutmass.com

upgrade.subject: Your OutMass Starter plan is active — thank you!
upgrade.text:
Hi Ada,

Thank you for upgrading — your Starter plan is active as of now. What
that means:

- You can send up to 2,500 emails per month.
- Your billing month starts today and renews monthly from this date —
  your quota resets on the same day, not on the 1st.
- See your usage anytime in the OutMass panel under Account, and manage
  or cancel via Manage Subscription.

If anything at all comes up — a question, a snag, a feature you're
missing — just reply to this email. It comes straight to me.

Thanks for backing a small product early. It means a lot.

Ali
Founder, OutMass

reauth.subject: Reconnect OutMass to Outlook
reauth.text:
Hi Ada,

Your OutMass connection to Microsoft Outlook has expired. Until you
reconnect, any scheduled campaigns and follow-ups will pause instead of
sending.

How to fix it: open the OutMass sidebar in Outlook Web, click the
Reconnect to Outlook banner, and sign in again. Takes about 10 seconds.

Reason: invalid_grant. If you keep seeing this, reply to this email and
we'll look into it.

— The OutMass team

account_deleted.subject: Your OutMass account has been deleted
account_deleted.text:
Hi Ada,

As you requested, your OutMass account and all associated data
(campaigns, contacts, templates, Microsoft authorization, and settings)
have been permanently removed.

Per our Privacy Policy, we retain an anonymised audit record for 5 years
to comply with fraud prevention and legal obligations. This record
contains only a hash of your email address and aggregate counters — no
content.

If you had an active paid subscription, it is managed separately through
Stripe. If you need help cancelling or getting a refund, reply to this
email.

Archive reference: arch-123

— The OutMass team

inactivity_30d_nudge.subject: Still using OutMass?
inactivity_30d_nudge.text:
Hi Ada,

We noticed you haven't used OutMass in about 30 days. A heads-up rather
than a nudge: your paid subscription is still active and still billed
each month, whether or not you open it.

If you still plan to use it, there's nothing to do — open Outlook on the
web and the OutMass panel is where you left it.

If something got in the way, tell us what it was. Just reply to this
email. That is genuinely the most useful thing you can send us, and a
person reads every one.

If you don't need it anymore, you can stop paying today:

- Open the OutMass panel → Account → Manage Subscription, or
- Reply here, or write to support@getoutmass.com — we'll cancel it and
  refund the current period.

You're receiving this because you have an active paid OutMass
subscription. This is a one-time note per inactive period.

— The OutMass team

inactivity_60d_warning.subject: Still paying for OutMass without using it?
inactivity_60d_warning.text:
Hi Ada,

You haven't logged into OutMass in around 60 days. Your paid
subscription has continued to renew during this time. We don't want you
paying for something you're not getting value from.

Three ways this can go:

- Keep it — open the OutMass panel in Outlook on the web, or reinstall
  it from the browser store you got it from. These emails stop as soon
  as you sign in.
- Tell us what went wrong — reply to this email. If something blocked
  you, we would much rather fix it than lose you.
- Cancel it — reply to this email or contact support@getoutmass.com and
  we'll cancel the subscription plus refund the current billing period.

If we don't hear back, we'll reach out one more time at the 90-day mark
before taking any further action.

— The OutMass team

inactivity_90d_warning.subject: OutMass — a final check-in
inactivity_90d_warning.text:
Hi Ada,

It's been about 90 days since you last used OutMass. We've written twice
already, and we don't want to keep charging you for something you aren't
using.

To stop paying, reply to this email or write to support@getoutmass.com —
we'll cancel the subscription and refund the current period, prorated.

If something stopped you from using it, we'd still like to know what.
One line in a reply is enough, and it is worth more to us than the
subscription.

If you just haven't got to it yet, open the OutMass panel in Outlook on
the web and these emails stop on their own.

This is the last automatic email we'll send about this. Your
subscription stays exactly as it is unless you tell us otherwise.

— The OutMass team
